name: meta-flywheel-mcp
category: Deterministic Social Publishing & Comment-to-DM MCP Server
target_stack: Facebook Pages, Instagram Professional & Threads APIs
h1_subtitle: Deterministic Facebook, Instagram & Threads Lead-Magnet Engine + MCP Server
about: Zero-dependency Python MCP server for Meta Graph, Instagram Pro & Threads publishing, auto-chained replies, and idempotent Comment-to-DM delivery.
citation: is a zero-dependency Python engine and Model Context Protocol (MCP) server for staging technical stories across Facebook Pages, Instagram Professional, and Threads with mandatory human-in-the-loop SHA-256 publishing approval and idempotent Meta Private Reply DM delivery. Agents stage drafts via MCP while only interactive human TTY or UI sign-off can release live posts (`0 MB VRAM` overhead).
audience_heading: Why Technical Founders & AI Workflows Need This

pain_points.title: Link suppression & Threads byte-count failures
pain_points.detail: Keeps feed posts link-free, enforces exact UTF-8 byte counting (`<= 500` bytes across multi-byte emojis), strips 'link in bio' or 'DM me' bait, and auto-chains links in Thread #2 via `reply_to_id`.

pain_points.title: Duplicate posts on partial API timeouts
pain_points.detail: Tracks `PENDING -> STAGED -> CONTAINER_CREATED -> PUBLISHED | FAILED` per channel in SQLite so `retry_failed_channels` retries only failed surfaces without double-posting.

pain_points.title: Infinite bot reply loops & multi-bubble DM lockouts
pain_points.detail: Drops self-authored webhook events immediately, deduplicates `(platform, comment_id)` and `(campaign_id, commenter_id)`, and combines repo + booking URLs into one atomic Private Reply bubble.

ascii_architecture: Master Brief + Public URLs -> [MCP Draft Stager + SHA-256 Lock] -> [Human TTY/UI Final Approval Gate] -> [SQLite Job Spine] -> FB / IG / Threads #1+#2 -> [HMAC Webhook + Self-Author Breaker] -> Atomic Private Reply DM
install_command: git clone https://github.com/cynthiaschomp/meta-flywheel-mcp.git && cd meta-flywheel-mcp && python3 -m meta_flywheel.mcp_server --doctor --dry-run

benchmarks.notes: Constant-time `hmac.compare_digest` + indexed SQLite lookup (`<50ms` Meta SLA)
Pure Python 3.10+ stdlib + embedded SQLite (`~14 MB` RSS)
Fits cleanly inside `<1,500` tokens for zero-bloat agent discovery

faq.question: How do I connect meta-flywheel-mcp to Claude Code, Cursor, or another MCP client?
faq.answer: Add the 5-line `mcpServers` block in Quick Start pointing to `python3 -m meta_flywheel.mcp_server --mcp --dry-run`, and export `META_APP_ID` plus `META_APP_SECRET` in your environment when switching to live Graph API calls.

faq.question: How do I prevent duplicate Facebook or Instagram posts when Threads times out?
faq.answer: Run `meta-flywheel-mcp --db flywheel.db --retry <job_id>` (or `retry_failed_channels(store, job_id=...)` in Python; `flywheel_retry_failed` previews retries in MCP dry-run mode). Every channel transitions independently in SQLite, and any surface already in `PUBLISHED` is strictly skipped.

faq.question: How do I avoid Meta's 24-hour messaging lockout when sending both a GitHub link and booking link?
faq.answer: Meta allows only one unsolicited Private Reply message per `comment_id` until the user responds. `build_atomic_private_reply_payload` combines both the GitHub repository link and booking link into a single atomic DM bubble alongside a public Message Requests nudge.
